profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ☁️ Salesforce ☁️ | Founding President @ ColorStack UF | MLH SRE Alum @ Google | CS Student @ University of Florida - Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering | CODE2040 Alum
profile.summary: Carson Johnson is a Computer Science student at the University of Florida. He gained his industry technical experience to be a Full-stack Software Engineer at the University of Central Florida full-stack coding boot camp. His experience as a Site Reliability Engineering Fellow with Google and Major League Hacking gives him the ability to scale and monitor large-scale applications. He is able to grasp new concepts quickly and implement them immediately to solve problems effectively. Ready to take on any challenge and do whatever it takes; to effectively solve big-picture problems. Great leadership abilities and can bring the best out of his team. Also equipped with an eagerness to listen, learn and follow the direction of a project manager to fit any role a team needs. His hunger to enhance the lives of people with technology is what motivates him.

positions.title: University of Florida Chapter, Founder & President
positions.description: Skills: Leadership · Teamwork · Communication · Accountability

positions.title: Founding President
positions.description:
- Founding President of the new student organization ColorStack at the University of Florida, with the mission to increase the number of Black, Latinx & Indigenous computer science graduates that go on the launch rewarding technical careers.
- Appointed, guided, and coached 23 different executive board members in creating professional development, academic support, and community-building support systems. 
- Led the executive board in securing 7 corporate partnerships, $20,000+ in funding for 170+ members, exclusive interview prep, and fireside chats within the first year of recognition.
- Orchestrated a 4-week NVIDIA Fundamentals of Deep Learning program in partnership with NVIDIA DLI resulting in 200+ students getting deep learning certified for free, saving participants over $100,000.

positions.title: NSBE Member
positions.description:
The National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE) is one of the largest student-governed organizations based in the United States. NSBE, founded in 1975, supports and promotes the aspirations of collegiate and pre-collegiate students and technical professionals in engineering and technology.

With more than 600 chapters and more than 24,000 active members in the U.S. and abroad, NSBE’s mission is “to increase the number of culturally responsible black engineers who excel academically, succeed professionally, and positively impact the community."

positions.title: Return SWE Intern Summer 2024
positions.description:
- Gained machine learning industry experience by developing, training and tuning a total of 54 machine learning models
- Technologies & Methodologies: Machine Learning, Performance Engineering, Pandas, Numpy, Kubernetes, Python
- Responsibilities: Predicted Kubernetes pod CPU and Memory utilization of varying performance tests
Contributed to solving an industry wide over-provisioning problem costing approximately $26.6B & 174Mt CO2
- Achieved top R² scores of 0.93 for CPU and 0.92 for Memory with XGBoost and Random Forest Regression
- Refined predictions with validation score of 0.96 for CPU and 0.93 for Memory using Neural Networks
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Jupyter · TensorFlow · NumPy · Pandas (Software) · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern Summer 2023
positions.description:
- Gained experience working on the Central Performance Foundations team by developing internal tools for performance teams
- Technologies & Methodologies:  JavaScript, React, Rete.js, AWS, Front-End, Argo Workflows, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, LWC
- Responsibilities: Developed an internal tool to improve performance testing workflow DAG orchestration utilizing Rete.js
- Performance team developers can model multi-step performance test workflows as a sequence of tasks using a DAG
- Utilized Rete.js library to allow developers to drag and drop workflow steps into the workflow DAG model
- Improved orchestration speed by creating prebuilt workflow templates, steps, and developers can save custom workflows
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · Front-End Development · React.js · JSON

positions.title: MLH Site Reliability Engineering (DevOps) Fellow
positions.description:
- 1 of 96 selected out of 4,000+ applicants to be a fellow

projects.title: Cooking Crafty
projects.description:
An application that recommends recipes based on what ingredients you have on your fridge. In this back-end server, you will have a plethora amount of data that surpasses a thanksgiving dinner.

Introduction
Have you struggled to find a meal in a market? Can't craft your own food? Well, drop by in Cooking Crafty! Just by looking at your fridge, we'll guide you on a snack that will make your parents less concerned!

Recipes
There are various recipes you can create with any ingredient you can come up with. If you want to add peanut butter to an apple pie, go for it. I personally wouldn't recommend it.

The CSS Framework
The Framework we used is Bulma. It is a very efficient CSS toolkit that helps us with our placeholders.

projects.title: GeoStream
projects.description:
GeoStream
A quick and intuitive movie search for the dinner-consuming personage.

Description
This team project is a movie finder app that helps you find where you can watch your favorite or any other shows.  Included is a most popular section that gives the user the most popular show at that time. Also added are a settings navigation icon and modal that will help the user pick preferred steaming services.

Live Site
https://cjohnson74.github.io/Geo-Stream/

Features
Search Bar
The search bar will auto-complete with suggestions to help make the user accessibility

Most Popular
We've added the most popular section to pull the posters of the most popular shows or movies at that current time.

User Settings
The settings add user preference to the page and allow the user to choose which service they want to show up in the project.

First Time User Experience
When you first open the page you will be toured through the page explaining all the features and options available to the user.

Tech Stack
html5 and CSS
The HTML and CSS were used for basic styling and skeleton of the page.

javascript
Javascript was used for almost every portion of this project and played a big part in the site development.

tailwinds CSS
Tailwinds was our choice of framework since not using bootstrap was in our parameters. It took some reading but the framework was easy to pick up and helped make our site look really well put together.

splidejs
We used this for our carousel projecting the most popular movies and shows.

auto-complete js
Used to auto-fill what the user may be searching.

introjs
We used this for the opening tutorial that takes you around the page and explains features and options to the user.

IMDb,OMDb, MovieDb
These were the sites we used APIs for to pull information to our site.
